== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sacred beasts are majestic, powerful creatures that differ from humans in their method of [[advancement]]. While humans must discover internal truths to trigger growth, [[sacred beasts]] advance by choosing to change their forms. They refine [[vital aura]] into [[madra]] within their bodies, a process that typically results in increased intelligence, strength, and beauty. However, some can appear hideous or diseased. As they advance, the distinction between [[sacred beasts]] and [[sacred artists]] diminishes, with both reaching similar peaks at the [[Sage]] or [[Herald]] stages. Some species, such as the [[Heavenly Sky Tigers]], possess unique biological needs, like consuming a sibling to gain enough [[madra]] to survive. These entities occupy various roles in the world; some live in [[ancestral trees]] and defend them, while others serve as powerful companions or contracted partners to [[sacred artists]]. Sacred beasts can take on humanoid forms to allow for more complex [[technique]] control, though this often requires sacrificing raw power. They range significantly in [[scale]], from small creatures to monsters as large as mountains. While most are natural beings, some can become corrupted into [[dreadbeasts]]—warped, monstrous versions of themselves often driven by [[hunger]]. In the hierarchy of power, certain [[sacred beasts]] can reach levels such as [[Underlord]] or Overlord, and some are even powerful enough to be considered similar to [[Dreadgods]].}}
